physical_setup.units: c=4pi=B0=L=1; L is transverse length, not long x-box length
physical_setup.boundaries: periodic x and z; unlike the paper absorbing x boundary; main packet does not wrap in displayed interval

pulse.profile: 0.3 sin(2pi*14*d) exp[-(d/.75)^6]; d is x/L-1 wrapped into [-2.5,2.5)
pulse.FFE_PIC: physical Bz=1+f, Ey=f, vx=f/(1+f), rho/rho0=sqrt(1+2f), p/p0=(rho/rho0)^gamma; finite-inertia PIC start is a force-free-limit wave
pulse.MHD: exact perpendicular SRMHD simplewave Riemann invariant; same lab magnetic pulse, model-dependent electric field and speed

alfven_seeds.resonance_note: All pairs have sum k=(14,0). kz7 is exactly resonant in FFE and nearest the cold-sigma100,beta0.01 MHD linear resonance kz=7*cF/vA=7.02329457. The shared families7/8/9,40pairs and phases are unchanged. Shared seeds do not imply all pairs are exactly resonant in every model.
alfven_seeds.nonlinear_constraints: Alfven transverse velocity divided by local guide compression; E=-v cross B includes finite-amplitude cross terms; Bx=0, Bz depends x, By depends x,z so divergence B=0.

PIC.psi_definition: E_AW,st/E_F0; E_AW,st=q n_total/k_perp in c=4pi=1, n_total includes both pair species
PIC.reference_convention: RMS kperp over all 80 equal-amplitude traveling daughter waves
PIC.temperature_note: PIC uses Maxwell-Juttner species; gamma-law initial enthalpy1.25 differs slightly from exact MJ enthalpy at theta.1; conduction drifts also add kinetic stress.
PIC.initial_current: FFE spatial current: J=rho_charge*(E cross B)/B^2 + [(B dot curlB - E dot curlE)/B^2]*B; replaces independent phase-transport derivative current only in PIC loading
PIC.species_loading: Common E cross B drift with equal/opposite parallel velocities; N=gamma(v_d)*rho/rho0, Nplus/minus=(N plus/minus rho_charge/C)/2, Vplus/minus=v_d plus/minus (J/C-rho_charge*v_d/C)/N. Exact charge/current; net parallel matter flux is determined by streams, not forced to zero.

MHD.solver: Athena++ SRMHD HLLE, RK3, PPM, CFL0.25; guarded primitive recovery
MHD.interpretation: Magnetically dominated SRMHD approaches the force-free wave regime while retaining matter inertia and pressure. The electric field follows the exact SRMHD simple-wave solution for the shared magnetic pulse. Changes in the compressive EM projection can include fast and slow components and are not a direct heating measurement.
MHD.primitive_recovery: Locally guarded Athena++ SRMHD recovery: previous-stage pressure guess, max100 iterations, dump raw conserved state and MPI_Abort on failure; production export requires no floor cells and maximum relative conserved mass/energy drift <=1e-6.

physical_setup.comparability: Shared magnetic pulse and seed pattern; model-dependent electric fields, currents, thermodynamics, and dispersion. MHD uses cold sigma100 and beta0.01, with initial fast-wave speed within1.2% of the force-free value but finite nonlinear steepening; FFE and PIC use the original completed production outputs. Production illustration without a convergence campaign.

display_adjustments.policy: If needed extend common crop to rightmost >=0.012 energy pixel plus0.05L margin; raise common energy bound to next0.01 above full-interval maximum; never change a single model separately

display_processing.crop: same fixed physical x window for all models and times; full z extent
display_processing.gaussian_boundary: periodic; normalized separable kernel radius ceil(3*sigma); applied on full energy maps before crop
display_processing.statistics_and_csv: full domain unsmoothed original energy maps

poster_style: monochrome intensity preview on white; RGB luminance of movie colors after the same energy/opacity mapping

energy_definitions.wave_em: .5*(E^2+|B-B0|^2): guide field removed before squaring; not total EM minus guide energy
energy_definitions.interpretation: Electromagnetic wave energy only; no plasma energy layer or heating inference
energy_definitions.spatial_processing: Energy scalars calculated at native resolution before block averaging to display grid

palette.name: White–blue–green–red with expanded low-energy colors
palette.source: User-requested multicolor display on a white background. Ordered positive-energy palette with explicit control points; not a diverging scale or an attribution to a published named colormap.
palette.direction: Ascending energy: white, blue, cyan, green, yellow, red, deep red; same physical mapping in all models and times
palette.normalization: Shared linear physical energy bound0.39 in every frame/model; the palette alone sets display color. Opacity remains independently defined by the fixed energy thresholds.

colors.alpha_transfer: smoothstep of absolute energy above threshold; fixed across all frames and models
colors.composition: wave over white; subthreshold transparent pixels reveal white

MHD.diagnostic_note: Crop omits weak downstream bath; full-domain unsmoothed diagnostics remain in CSV

FFE.diagnostic_note: Crop omits weak downstream bath; full-domain unsmoothed diagnostics remain in CSV

PIC.diagnostic_note: Crop omits weak downstream bath; full-domain unsmoothed diagnostics remain in CSV

MHD.averaging: Compute scalar energies on native cell centers, then block-average to display pixels

energy_definitions.plasma_excess: plasma_kinetic_internal-p0/(Gamma-1); signed excess above uniform thermal background, not spatial t0 subtraction
energy_definitions.plasma_kinetic_internal: plasma_t00-plasma_rest_mass; includes bulk motion and internal energy
energy_definitions.wave_em: 0.5*(E^2+|B-B0|^2); guide field removed before squaring; nonnegative

MHD.interpretation: Plasma excess includes compression, motion, and transport; it is not a direct heating measurement. Wave EM omits the guide-field cross term and is not total EM change.
MHD.units: c=B0=L=4pi=1; energy density in B0^2 units

FFE.collocation: Native cell centers; ghost removal by coordinates; scalar energies formed before 3x3 block averaging

definitions.em_excess: 0.5*(|E|^2+|B|^2-B0^2), B0=1; signed total electromagnetic energy density above uniform guide field
definitions.plasma_excess: Zero placeholder: FFE has no evolved material energy; electromagnetic loss is not assigned to plasma heating
definitions.wave_em: 0.5*(|E|^2+|B-B0*z_hat|^2), B0=1; paper wave electromagnetic energy density

PIC.averaging: Compute scalar electromagnetic energy on native cell centers before 4x4 block averages to display pixels

energy_definitions.wave_em: 0.5*(E^2+|B-B0|^2); guide field removed before squaring; nonnegative

PIC.interpretation: Wave EM omits the guide-field cross term and is not total EM change.
PIC.plasma_energy_status: Spatial particle energy was not saved in this completed production; no plasma map is supplied.

runtime_provenance.initial_current: Spatial force-free current of frozen B/E; exact charge/current, common E-cross-B drift, equal/opposite parallel streams; parallel number flux unconstrained

initial_loading_parameter_calculation.current_definition: J=rho_charge*(E cross B)/B² + (B dot curlB - E dot curlE)*B/B²
initial_loading_parameter_calculation.note: Necessary initial-density/current admissibility calculation only, no solver evolution or validation campaign
initial_loading_parameter_calculation.sampling: Native-grid cell centres; production loader additionally checks every actual quiet-loading point

PIC.units: c=B0=L=4pi=1; energy density in B0^2 units
